column1: # Admin1 name overrides: GeoNames admin1 code -> seeded state space name.
# Used when the GeoNames admin1 name differs from the seeded state name
# (language variants, abbreviations). Loaded over admin1_codes.tsv, so the
# GeoNames name never reaches name-matching for these codes.
# Format: <country ISO2>\t<geonames admin1 code>\t<seeded state name>
# Nigeria — GeoNames names FCT "FCT"; seeded state is "Federal Capital Territory".
# Indonesia — seeded states use Indonesian names (and island-level parents
# like 'Jawa'/'Sumatera' exist); GeoNames uses English ("West Java").
